== Biography ==
James Glasgow was born about 1813. His age was recorded as 38 at his marriage in 1851, and the same record identifies his father as [[Glasgow-1622|Adam Glasgow]].<ref>FamilySearch, database, “Ireland Marriages, 1619–1898,” entry for James Glasgow and Rosanna Barkley, married 17 March 1851 at Portglenone, County Antrim, Ireland; citing p. 153, line 89; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FGC7-SDN FamilySearch record FGC7-SDN].</ref>

On 17 March 1851, [[Glasgow-1623|James Glasgow]] married Rosanna Barkley at Portglenone, County Antrim, Ireland. James was recorded as aged 38 and Rosanna as aged 25. Rosanna’s father was named as Henry Barkley.<ref>FamilySearch, database, “Ireland Marriages, 1619–1898,” entry for James Glasgow and Rosanna Barkley, married 17 March 1851 at Portglenone, County Antrim, Ireland; citing p. 153, line 89; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FGC7-SDN FamilySearch record FGC7-SDN].</ref>

Four years before the marriage, a family letter reported that James was believed to have fathered a child with a daughter of Henry Barkly. On 20 March 1847, [[Glasgow-822|John Glasgow (1767-1851)]] of Londonderry, Ohio, referred to news contained in a letter sent from Ireland by R. Mulhollan on 22 December 1846. John wrote that the family believed “James Glasgow has an illegitimate heir, by his servant maid Henry Barkly daughter.”

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1622]] is assessed at 99% (proved). James’s original Portglenone marriage of 17 March 1851 gives age 38 and father Adam. Adam-1622 represents that expressly named father, matching James’s c 1813 birth.

Confident for this record-defined father; Adam’s proposed upstream link and the older James-3903 remain separate.

Next useful test: Use Adam’s own records to resolve his ancestry, without transferring the older James’s monument.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FGC7-SDN "Ireland Marriages, 1619–1898," database, FamilySearch (record FGC7-SDN (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FGC7-SDN)), marriage of James Glasgow and Rosanna Barkley, 17 March 1851, Portglenone, County Antrim, Ireland; citing p. 153, line 89.].
